scene.note: Four queries put the practice's records in the order each question needs, and one keeps only the first few.

steps.note: Every owner comes in, in whatever order the records happen to be in.
The owners are sorted by surname, the way the paper cards are.

value.label: the shape of what comes back

steps.note: Winnie reads the list from the top, A to Z, and finds a name without scrolling.
Every animal comes in. Only the dogs stay.
The dogs are sorted by weight, and the direction is turned so the biggest comes first.
A dog nobody has weighed has an empty weight. Where it lands depends on how this database sorts empty cells.

value.label: the shape of what comes back

steps.note: Ifan works down the list as he doses the tablets.
Every visit comes in, both vets mixed together.
The visits are sorted by vet first, so each vet's visits sit together.
Inside each vet, the date decides, newest first. Each column has its own direction.

value.label: the shape of what comes back

steps.note: Rosamund reads one vet's recent work, then the other's.
Every animal comes in. Some have a birthday nobody knows.
The animals are sorted by birthday, oldest first, and the unknown birthdays are kept from the top.
Two animals share a birthday, so a second column says which comes first.

value.label: the shape of what comes back

steps.note: Only the first three rows are kept, the same three every time.
